media_bilingual.title: Media to bilingual subtitles
media_bilingual.summary: Transcribe → translate → export → bilingual file names
media_bilingual.description: Transcribe the audio or video in a folder with the local model, translate it, save the subtitles next to each file, and optionally give the files bilingual names.

fusionkit.intro: Please run this workflow for me:
fusionkit.step_transcribe: 1. Transcribe every audio and video file in `{{path}}`{{recursive}} with local speech recognition. Spoken language: {{spoken}}.
fusionkit.step_translate: 2. Translate each file into {{target}} as soon as it is transcribed and export a subtitle file ({{layout}}, format: {{format}}) next to the media file; if a file with that name exists, add a number instead of overwriting. Submit transcription, translation and export as one batch.
fusionkit.step_rename: 3. When all subtitles are exported, translate the names of these media files and exported subtitle files into bilingual names: {{name}}; keep the extensions and rename only these files. Show me the rename preview first.

external.intro: Please run this workflow with FusionKit's MCP tools (the fusionkit server), writing the translations yourself:
external.step_transcribe: 1. Transcribe the audio and video in `{{path}}`{{recursive}} with start_studio_transcription (recursive={{recursiveBool}}, language={{spokenCode}}) and follow get_studio_tasks (kind=transcription) until all are done.
external.step_translate: 2. For each transcribed Subtitle Studio document: read the source with read_studio_document, translate every line into {{target}} yourself, create a track with create_studio_translation_track and write it in batches with write_studio_translations.
external.step_export: 3. Export each document with export_studio_document: content={{content}}, order={{order}}, format={{formatCode}}, destination=source_directory, conflict=indexed.
external.step_rename: 4. Finally list these media files and exported subtitles with inspect_name_paths, translate their names into bilingual names yourself: {{name}}, keeping the extensions, and submit them with rename_paths; I'll confirm in FusionKit.

convert_subtitles.title: Convert subtitle formats
convert_subtitles.summary: Turn a folder of subtitles into LRC, SRT and more
convert_subtitles.description: Finds the subtitle files in a folder and converts them, saving each next to its original. Files already in the target format are skipped.
convert_subtitles.fusionkit: Convert every subtitle file in `{{path}}`{{recursive}} to {{to}} and save each next to its original; {{overwrite}}. Skip files already in {{to}}; work in batches if there are many, and tell me how many succeeded and failed.
convert_subtitles.external: Please use FusionKit's MCP tool convert_subtitle_files to convert every subtitle file in `{{path}}`{{recursive}} to {{to}}: paths=["{{path}}"], to={{toCode}}, recursive={{recursiveBool}}, conflict={{conflict}}, output next to each file. Call it in batches above 200 files, then tell me how many succeeded and failed.

bilingual_names.title: Bilingual file names
bilingual_names.summary: Rename files or folders to "Translated - Original"
bilingual_names.description: Translates the names of files or folders in a folder. You get a rename preview first, nothing changes until you confirm, and it can be undone.
bilingual_names.fusionkit: Translate the names of the {{kind}} in `{{path}}`{{recursive}} into {{target}}. Name format: {{name}}; keep the extensions. Make a rename preview for me to confirm first.
bilingual_names.external: Please rename with FusionKit's MCP tools: list the {{kind}} to rename with inspect_name_paths (paths=["{{path}}"], {{includeChildren}}); translate the names into {{target}} yourself, name format: {{name}}, keeping the extensions; submit them with rename_paths (up to 500 per call) and I'll confirm in FusionKit. Then tell me the journalId so undo_name_changes can undo it if needed.

translate_subtitles.title: Translate subtitle files
translate_subtitles.summary: Translate a folder of subtitles, saved next to them
translate_subtitles.description: Translates the subtitle files in a folder into another language, bilingual or translation only.
translate_subtitles.fusionkit: Translate the subtitle files in `{{path}}`{{recursive}} into {{target}}, output: {{layout}}, saved next to the originals; don't overwrite existing files.
translate_subtitles.external: Please translate subtitles with FusionKit's MCP tools, writing the translations yourself: import the subtitle files in `{{path}}`{{recursive}} with import_studio_subtitles (recursive={{recursiveBool}}); for each document read it with read_studio_document, translate it into {{target}} yourself and write it with create_studio_translation_track and write_studio_translations; then export with export_studio_document (content={{content}}, order={{order}}, format=auto, destination=source_directory, conflict=indexed).

extract_language.title: Extract one language
extract_language.summary: Keep only Chinese, Japanese… from bilingual subtitles
extract_language.description: Takes one language out of bilingual subtitles into new files saved next to the originals.
extract_language.fusionkit: From the bilingual subtitles in `{{path}}`{{recursive}}, keep only {{keep}} and save the new subtitle files next to the originals.
extract_language.external: Please use FusionKit's MCP tool extract_subtitle_language: paths=["{{path}}"], keep={{keepCode}}, recursive={{recursiveBool}}, conflict=indexed, to keep only {{keep}} from the bilingual subtitles, output next to each file. Then tell me how many succeeded and failed.

resume_translation.title: Resume unfinished translations
resume_translation.summary: Scan recovery records and continue where it stopped
resume_translation.description: FusionKit leaves recovery records when a subtitle translation stops. Scan a folder to continue from where they left off.
resume_translation.fusionkit: Scan `{{path}}` for subtitle translation recovery records and finish the translations that are not done yet.
